Split a failure count into data_generator() vs method() failures (#43 G3)

Source: R/analyze.R
dot-medsim_failure_split.Rd

A data_generator() failure row (error prefixed "data_generator error: ") means the estimator never ran for that replication – lumping it into the same failure_rate as a method() failure (estimator ran, produced no usable CI) conflates two different reliability signals. failure_rate and dgp_failure_rate deliberately use DIFFERENT denominators and do not sum to an overall failure fraction: failure_rate is conditional on the DGP having succeeded (excludes DGP-failure reps from both numerator and denominator); dgp_failure_rate is unconditional (always over n_total).

Usage

.medsim_failure_split(error_vec, n_valid, n_total)

Arguments

error_vec

The (possibly NULL) error column for these rows, BEFORE any NA-based valid/invalid subsetting.

n_valid

Count of rows with a usable (non-NA) CI/truth (post-filter).

n_total

Total row count for this parameter/scenario, before filtering (same basis error_vec is indexed against).

Value

list(n_failed, failure_rate, n_dgp_failed, dgp_failure_rate).
